**Product Title:**  
SmartFit Pro X1 Smartwatch

**Short Marketing Description:**  
Stay connected and in control with the SmartFit Pro X1 Smartwatch. Featuring a vibrant 1.9-inch AMOLED display, Bluetooth calling, and advanced health tracking, it’s designed to support your active lifestyle with style and convenience.

**Key Features:**  
- 1.9-inch AMOLED display for a clear, vivid viewing experience  
- Bluetooth calling for easy communication on the go  
- Up to 7-day battery life for extended use  
- Heart-rate monitoring to help track your wellness  
- Sleep tracking for better rest insights  
- IP68 waterproof design for everyday durability  
- Fitness activity tracking to support your goals  

**Promotional Tagline:**  
Smart style. Powerful tracking. Built for every day.
